Thanks for contributing. Draft pull requests and questions are welcome.

## Summary

What changed?

## Why?

What problem does this solve, and is there a related issue, work item, or ADR?

## Validation

List the relevant commands and their results. If you could not run a check,
say why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I linked related context or explained why there is no issue.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and checks, or described what remains.
- [ ] I updated documentation or tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I reviewed the [documentation affected by this change](https://github.com/animu-sphere/usd-roadnetwork-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation-review) and kept each status claim in its source document.
- [ ] I did not add private or unlicensed assets. Any third-party file or code has its license stated beside it and in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

## Reviewer notes

Call out compatibility changes, known limitations, or areas where you want
focused review.
